title: Researchers design PVT heat pump with single integrated evaporator
content:
The dual-source photovoltaic-thermal (PVT) heat pump combines solar and ambient-air heat collection in a single finned evaporator, eliminating the need for separate heat exchangers. The researchers say the simplified design could reduce installation costs.

title: Waste solar silicon repurposed as support for palladium nanoparticle catalysts
content:

The catalyst achieved high yields, recyclability, and lower environmental impact compared with conventional silicon and carbon-based supports.

content:

title: Distributed solar supplied 27% of Pakistan’s electricity in 2025
content:
Analysis by the Pakistan Solar Association finds roughly 51 TWh of generation that never appears on grid-side data, as rooftop and off-grid solar spreads faster than official statistics. The association claims unseen generation can be inferred from a deepening midday demand trough, with network design suffering as a result.
